title: NOESIS record candidate contract 0.1.0
description: Design contract for versioned universal records; structural validation does not establish provenance truth, authorization, or implementation. External IDs are reserved documentation identifiers, not hosted schema endpoints.

scope.description: Identity and classification only; the authenticated service enforces actual grants. Null contextual IDs mean unknown or not applicable.

artifact_ref.description: Resolve by authorized artifact_id. Locator is descriptive and never permission to fetch arbitrary content. Digests are present only when actually computed.

range.description: Units and endpoints refer to the declared source. The service validates ordering and indexing conventions.

coverage.description: Complete is relative to the described bounded input; unknown totals are null. Runtime enforces processed <= total when both are known.

provenance.description: The service assigns creator/origin from trusted transport and capture context. Source refs and derived refs do not create independent corroboration.

activation.description: Ebb changes only score. Retention, confidence, validity, and adoption are independent.

retention.description: Eligibility is not automatic deletion. An explicit bounded worker evaluates the named policy; Ebb never changes these fields.

hypothesis_payload.description: Predicted outcomes are imagined, not empirical evidence. Supporting real evidence must be ingested independently and retain its lineage.

tombstone_payload.description: Must contain no erased body content. Residual locations are redacted descriptions, not retained sensitive content.

resource_knowledge.description: A scoped statement about what was referenced, examined, used, or specifically verified. These are independent evidence states, not a universal knowledge percentage or confidence ladder.
